title: Three Marks mod user badge
description: The badge next to the names of players who use the mod (docs/specs/2026-10-06-modpack-user-badge.md). POST /mod/badges/preference body #/definitions/preference -> 200 #/definitions/preferenceAnswer stores whether other players see the badge of this device's account (config show_pack_badge, on by default; the companion reports it once per account after binding and on every change, false while the whole mod is off); until a device reports it the account is never marked. POST /mod/badges body #/definitions/request -> 200 #/definitions/answer, once per own battle (never in a replay): account_ids are the arena players' account ids, without the own account, bots, event bots and anonymised players; the answer is the subset whose account has an active (not revoked) device seen in the last 30 days that reported true, no active device that reported false, and no deletion request. The server keeps no table, cache or log of the ids; it counts the distinct account ids each device asks about per Moscow day, stored only as keyed hashes (HMAC of the day and the id) that expire after two days, and past 1500 distinct ids in a day the read is refused with 429 rate_limited and a Retry-After until the next day (ids already asked that day never count again, so a request of only known ids passes even at the cap). Both are signed exactly like /mod/ingest (v2: X-Otmetki-Device, X-Otmetki-Timestamp, X-Otmetki-Nonce, X-Otmetki-Signature over the raw body); a body naming another account than the device's is refused with 403 account_mismatch; 400 invalid_payload; 401 unknown device or bad signature (rebind); 403 device_revoked; 429 with Retry-After when rate-limited (30 reads, 10 preference writes per minute and device); every error reply carries X-Otmetki-Server-Time. POST /mod/badges/presence body #/definitions/presence -> 200 #/definitions/answer is the current route (revised 2026-10-08, owner's decision): no binding, no site account, unsigned and anonymous, no device headers. account_id is the sender's own account, visible its show_pack_badge switch, account_ids the battle's other players (may be empty, then the answer is empty). The server keeps only a 30-day presence key per account in Redis (otmetki:mod:presence:<account_id>): visible=true sets it and refreshes the 30 days on every call (never for an account with a data-deletion request: then it is deleted instead), visible=false deletes it at once, and a data-deletion purge deletes it too; nothing else is stored. The answer is the asked ids that have a presence key, minus hidden players and accounts with a data-deletion request; bound devices and their reported switch play no part. Throttled per client IP (30 per minute) and by the same 1500 distinct asked ids per Moscow day, counted per keyed hash of the client network (an IPv6 client counts against both its /56 and its /48); past it 429 rate_limited with Retry-After; 400 invalid_payload. Because the route is unsigned anyone can claim any account_id, so to bound forging (visible=true) and wiping (visible=false) of other players' presence one client network may report at most 5 distinct own account_id values per Moscow day (same keyed-hash sets); past that the presence write is silently ignored while the lookup is still answered. The signed routes above stay for older mods.
